text.la: Ne reminiscáris, Dómine, delícta nostra, vel paréntum nostrórum: neque vindíctam sumas de peccátis nostris.

text.en-US: Psalm 6
text.la: Psalmus 6
Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, neque in ira tua corrípias me.
text.en-US: Lord, rebuke me not in thy indignation, nor chastise me in thy wrath.

text.la: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum: sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.
text.en-US: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

text.la: Et ánima mea turbáta est valde: sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?
text.en-US: And my soul is troubled exceedingly: but thou, O Lord, how long?

text.la: Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.
text.en-US: Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: O save me for thy mercy's sake.

text.la: Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui: in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?
text.en-US: For there is no one in death, that is mindful of thee: and who shall confess to thee in hell?

text.la: Laborávi in gémitu meo, † lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum: lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.
text.en-US: I have laboured in my groanings, † every night I will wash my bed: I will water my couch with my tears.

text.la: Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus: inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.
text.en-US: My eye is troubled through indignation: I have grown old amongst all my enemies.

text.la: Discédite a me, omnes, qui operámini iniquitátem: quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.
text.en-US: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

text.la: Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam, Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.
text.en-US: The Lord hath heard my supplication: the Lord hath received my prayer.

text.la: Erubéscant, et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei: convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.
text.en-US: Let all my enemies be ashamed, and be very much troubled: let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.
Psalm 31
text.la: Psalmus 31
Beáti quorum remíssae sunt iniquitátes: et quorum tecta sunt peccáta.
text.en-US: Blessed are those whose iniquities are forgiven and whose sins are covered.

text.la: Beátus vir, cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum, nec est in spíritu eius dolus.
text.en-US: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord hath not imputed sin, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

text.la: Quóniam tácui, inveteravérunt ossa mea, dum clamárem tota die.
text.en-US: Because I was silent my bones grew old; whilst I cried out all the day long.

text.la: Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua: convérsus sum in aerúmna mea, dum confígitur spina.
text.en-US: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: I am turned in my anguish, whilst the thorn is fastened.

text.la: Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci: et iniustítiam meam non abscóndi.
text.en-US: I have acknowledged my sin to thee, and my injustice I have not concealed.

text.la: Dixi: Confitébor advérsum me iniustítiam meam Dómino: et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei.
text.en-US: I said I will confess against myself my injustice to the Lord: and thou hast forgiven the wickedness of my sin.

text.la: Pro hac orábit ad te omnis sanctus, in témpore opportúno.
text.en-US: For this shall every one that is holy pray to thee in a seasonable time.

text.la: Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum, ad eum non approximábunt.
text.en-US: And yet in a flood of many waters, they shall not come nigh unto him.

text.la: Tu es refúgium meum a tribulatióne, quae circúmdedit me: exsultátio mea, érue me a circumdántibus me.
text.en-US: Thou art my refuge from the trouble which hath encompassed me: my joy, deliver me from them that surround me.

text.la: Intelléctum tibi dabo, et ínstruam te in via hac, qua gradiéris: firmábo super te óculos meos.
text.en-US: I will give thee understanding, and I will instruct thee in this way, in which thou shalt go: I will fix my eyes upon thee.

text.la: Nolíte fíeri sicut equus et mulus, quibus non est intelléctus.
text.en-US: Do not become like the horse and the mule, who have no understanding.

text.la: In camo et freno maxíllas eórum constrínge, qui non appróximant ad te.
text.en-US: With bit and bridle bind fast their jaws, who come not near unto thee.

text.la: Multa flagélla peccatóris, sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit.
text.en-US: Many are the scourges of the sinner, but mercy shall encompass him that hopeth in the Lord.

text.la: Laetámini in Dómino et exsultáte, iusti, et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.
text.en-US: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye just, and glory, all ye right of heart.
Psalm 37
text.la: Psalmus 37
Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, neque in ira tua corrípias me.
text.en-US: Rebuke me not, O Lord, in thy indignation; nor chastise me in thy wrath.

text.la: Quóniam sagíttae tuae infíxae sunt mihi: et confirmásti super me manum tuam.
text.en-US: For thy arrows are fastened in me: and thy hand hath been strong upon me.

text.la: Non est sánitas in carne mea a fácie irae tuae: non est pax óssibus meis a fácie peccatórum meórum.
text.en-US: There is no health in my flesh, because of thy wrath: there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.

text.la: Quóniam iniquitátes meae supergréssae sunt caput meum: et sicut onus grave gravátae sunt super me.
text.en-US: For my iniquities are gone over my head: and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.

text.la: Putruérunt et corrúptae sunt cicatríces meae, a fácie insipiéntiae meae.
text.en-US: My sores are putrified and corrupted, because of my foolishness.

text.la: Miser factus sum, et curvátus sum usque in finem: tota die contristátus ingrediébar.
text.en-US: I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: I walked sorrowful all the day long.

text.la: Quóniam lumbi mei impléti sunt illusiónibus: et non est sánitas in carne mea.
text.en-US: For my loins are filled with illusions; and there is no health in my flesh.

text.la: Afflíctus sum, et humiliátus sum nimis: rugiébam a gémitu cordis mei.
text.en-US: I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: I roared with the groaning of my heart.

text.la: Dómine, ante te omne desidérium meum: et gémitus meus a te non est abscónditus.
text.en-US: Lord, all my desire is before thee, and my groaning is not hidden from thee.

text.la: Cor meum conturbátum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.
text.en-US: My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me, and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.

text.la: Amíci mei, et próximi mei advérsum me appropinquavérunt, et stetérunt.
text.en-US: My friends and my neighbours have drawn near, and stood against me.

text.la: Et qui iuxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: et vim faciébant qui quaerébant ánimam meam.
text.en-US: And they that were near me stood afar off: and they that sought my soul used violence.

text.la: Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: et dolos tota die meditabántur.
text.en-US: And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, and studied deceits all the day long.

text.la: Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.
text.en-US: But I, as a deaf man, heard not: and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.

text.la: Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.
text.en-US: And I became as a man that heareth not: and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.

text.la: Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: tu exáudies me, Dómine, Deus meus.
text.en-US: For in thee, O Lord, have I hoped: thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.

text.la: Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: et dum commovéntur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.
text.en-US: For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.

text.la: Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.
text.en-US: For I am ready for scourges: and my sorrow is continually before me.

text.la: Quóniam iniquitátem meam annuntiábo: et cogitábo pro peccáto meo.
text.en-US: For I will declare my iniquity: and I will think for my sin.

text.la: Inimíci autem mei vivunt, et confirmáti sunt super me: et multiplicáti sunt qui odérunt me iníque.
text.en-US: But my enemies live, and are stronger than I: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

text.la: Qui retríbuunt mala pro bonis, detrahébant mihi: quóniam sequébar bonitátem.
text.en-US: They that render evil for good, have detracted me, because I followed goodness.

text.la: Ne derelínquas me, Dómine, Deus meus: ne discésseris a me.
text.en-US: Forsake me not, O Lord my God: do not thou depart from me.

text.la: Inténde in adiutórium meum, Dómine, Deus, salútis meae.
text.en-US: Attend unto my help, O Lord, the God of my salvation.
Psalm 50
text.la: Psalmus 50
Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
text.en-US: Have mercy on me, O God, according to thy great mercy.

text.la: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, dele iniquitátem meam.
text.en-US: And according to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my iniquity.

text.la: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: et a peccáto meo munda me.
text.en-US: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

text.la: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
text.en-US: For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me.

text.la: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: ut iustificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum iudicáris.
text.en-US: To thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before thee: that thou mayst be justified in thy words, and mayst overcome when thou art judged.

text.la: Ecce enim, in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
text.en-US: For behold I was conceived in iniquities; and in sins did my mother conceive me.

text.la: Ecce enim, veritátem dilexísti: incérta et occúlta sapiéntiae tuae manifestásti mihi.
text.en-US: For behold thou hast loved truth: the uncertain and hidden things of thy wisdom thou hast made manifest to me.

text.la: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
text.en-US: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

text.la: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et laetítiam: et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
text.en-US: To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

text.la: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
text.en-US: Turn away thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

text.la: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
text.en-US: Create a clean heart in me, O God: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

text.la: Ne proícias me a fácie tua: et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
text.en-US: Cast me not away from thy face; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

text.la: Redde mihi laetítiam salutáris tui: et spíritu principáli confírma me.
text.en-US: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

text.la: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: et ímpii ad te converténtur.
text.en-US: I will teach the unjust thy ways: and the wicked shall be converted to thee.

text.la: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meae: et exsultábit lingua mea iustítiam tuam.
text.en-US: Deliver me from blood, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol thy justice.

text.la: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
text.en-US: O Lord, thou wilt open my lips: and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

text.la: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: holocáustis non delectáberis.
text.en-US: For if thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings thou wilt not be delighted.

text.la: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: cor contrítum, et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
text.en-US: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

text.la: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: ut aedificéntur muri Ierúsalem.
text.en-US: Deal favourably, O Lord, in thy good will with Sion; that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

text.la: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium iustítiae, oblatiónes, et holocáusta: tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
text.en-US: Then shalt thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: then shall they lay calves upon thy altar.
Psalm 101
text.la: Psalmus 101
Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: et clamor meus ad te véniat.
text.en-US: Hear, O Lord, my prayer: and let my cry come to thee.

text.la: Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: in quacúmque die tríbulor, inclína ad me aurem tuam.
text.en-US: Turn not away thy face from me: in the day when I am in trouble, incline thy ear to me.

text.la: In quacúmque die invocávero te, velóciter exáudi me.
text.en-US: In what day soever I shall call upon thee, hear me speedily.

text.la: Quia defecérunt sicut fumus dies mei: et ossa mea sicut crémium aruérunt.
text.en-US: For my days are vanished like smoke: and my bones are grown dry like fuel for the fire.

text.la: Percússus sum ut faenum, et áruit cor meum: quia oblítus sum comédere panem meum.
text.en-US: I am smitten as grass, and my heart is withered: because I forgot to eat my bread.

text.la: A voce gémitus mei adhaésit os meum carni meae.
text.en-US: Through the voice of my groaning, my bone hath cleaved to my flesh.

text.la: Símilis factus sum pellicáno solitúdinis: factus sum sicut nyctícorax in domicílio.
text.en-US: I am become like to a pelican of the wilderness: I am like a night raven in the house.

text.la: Vigilávi, et factus sum sicut passer solitárius in tecto.
text.en-US: I have watched, and am become as a sparrow all alone on the housetop.

text.la: Tota die exprobrábant mihi inimíci mei: et qui laudábant me, advérsum me iurábant.
text.en-US: All the day long my enemies reproached me: and they that praised me did swear against me.

text.la: Quia cínerem tamquam panem manducábam, et potum meum cum fletu miscébam.
text.en-US: For I did eat ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.

text.la: A fácie irae et indignatiónis tuae: quia élevans allisísti me.
text.en-US: Because of thy anger and indignation: for having lifted me up thou hast thrown me down.

text.la: Dies mei sicut umbra declinavérunt: et ego sicut faenum árui.
text.en-US: My days have declined like a shadow, and I am withered like grass.

text.la: Tu autem, Dómine, in aetérnum pérmanes: et memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.
text.en-US: But thou, O Lord, endurest for ever: and thy memorial to all generations.

text.la: Tu exsúrgens miseréberis Sion: quia tempus miseréndi eius, quia venit tempus.
text.en-US: Thou shalt arise and have mercy on Sion: for it is time to have mercy on it, for the time is come.

text.la: Quóniam placuérunt servis tuis lápides eius: et terrae eius miserebúntur.
text.en-US: For the stones thereof have pleased thy servants: and they shall have pity on the earth thereof.

text.la: Et timébunt gentes nomen tuum, Dómine, et omnes reges terrae glóriam tuam.
text.en-US: And the Gentiles shall fear thy name, O Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

text.la: Quia aedificávit Dóminus Sion: et vidébitur in glória sua.
text.en-US: For the Lord hath built up Sion: and he shall be seen in his glory.

text.la: Respéxit in oratiónem humílium: et non sprevit precem eórum.
text.en-US: He hath had regard to the prayer of the humble: and he hath not despised their petition.

text.la: Scribántur haec in generatióne áltera: et pópulus, qui creábitur, laudábit Dóminum:
text.en-US: Let these things be written unto another generation: and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord:

text.la: Quia prospéxit de excélso sancto suo: Dóminus de caelo in terram aspéxit:
text.en-US: Because he hath looked forth from his high sanctuary: from heaven the Lord hath looked upon the earth.

text.la: Ut audíret gémitus compeditórum: ut sólveret fílios interemptórum:
text.en-US: That he might hear the groans of them that are in fetters: that he might release the children of the slain:

text.la: Ut annúntient in Sion nomen Dómini: et laudem eius in Ierúsalem.
text.en-US: That they may declare the name of the Lord in Sion: and his praise in Jerusalem;

text.la: In conveniéndo pópulos in unum, et reges ut sérviant Dómino.
text.en-US: When the people assemble together, and kings, to serve the Lord.

text.la: Respóndit ei in via virtútis suae: Paucitátem diérum meórum núntia mihi.
text.en-US: He answered him in the way of his strength: Declare unto me the fewness of my days.

text.la: Ne révoces me in dimídio diérum meórum: in generatiónem et generatiónem anni tui.
text.en-US: Call me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are unto generation and generation.

text.la: Inítio tu, Dómine, terram fundásti: et ópera mánuum tuárum sunt caeli.
text.en-US: In the beginning, O Lord, thou foundedst the earth: and the heavens are the works of thy hands.

text.la: Ipsi períbunt, tu autem pérmanes: et omnes sicut vestiméntum veteráscent.
text.en-US: They shall perish but thou remainest: and all of them shall grow old like a garment:

text.la: Et sicut opertórium mutábis eos, et mutabúntur: tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non defícient.
text.en-US: And as a vesture thou shalt change them, and they shall be changed. But thou art always the selfsame, and thy years shall not fail.

text.la: Fílii servórum tuórum habitábunt: et semen eórum in saéculum dirigétur.
text.en-US: The children of thy servants shall continue: and their seed shall be directed for ever.
Psalm 129
text.la: Psalmus 129
De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: (2a) Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:
text.en-US: Out of the depths I have cried to thee, O Lord: (2a) Lord, hear my voice.

text.la: Fiant aures tuae intendéntes, in vocem deprecatiónis meae.
text.en-US: Let thy ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication.

text.la: Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: Dómine, quis sustinébit?
text.en-US: If thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities: Lord, who shall stand it.

text.la: Quia apud te propitiátio est: et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.
text.en-US: For with thee there is merciful forgiveness: and by reason of thy law, I have waited for thee, O Lord.

text.la: Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo eius: (5) sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.
text.en-US: My soul hath relied on his word: (5) my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

text.la: A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: speret Israël in Dómino.
text.en-US: From the morning watch even until night, let Israel hope in the Lord.

text.la: Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
text.en-US: Because with the Lord there is mercy: and with him plentiful redemption.

text.la: Et ipse rédimet Israël, ex ómnibus iniquitátibus eius.
text.en-US: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
Psalm 142
text.la: Psalmus 142
Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: áuribus pércipe obsecratiónem meam in veritáte tua: exáudi me in tua iustítia.
text.en-US: Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in thy truth: hear me in thy justice.

text.la: Et non intres in iudícium cum servo tuo: quia non iustificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.
text.en-US: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.

text.la: Quia persecútus est inimícus ánimam meam: humiliávit in terra vitam meam.
text.en-US: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul: he hath brought down my life to the earth.

text.la: Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos saéculi: (4) et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.
text.en-US: He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old: (4) and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.

text.la: Memor fui diérum antiquórum, meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.
text.en-US: I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy works: I meditated upon the works of thy hands.

text.la: Expándi manus meas ad te: ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
text.en-US: I stretched forth my hands to thee: my soul is as earth without water unto thee.

text.la: Velóciter exáudi me, Dómine: defécit spíritus meus.
text.en-US: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit hath fainted away.

text.la: Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.
text.en-US: Turn not away thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

text.la: Audítam fac mihi mane misericórdiam tuam: quia in te sperávi.
text.en-US: Cause me to hear thy mercy in the morning; for in thee have I hoped.

text.la: Notam fac mihi viam, in qua ámbulem: quia ad te levávi ánimam meam.
text.en-US: Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: for I have lifted up my soul to thee.

text.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi: (10a) doce me fácere voluntátem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu.
text.en-US: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to thee have I fled: (10a) teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God.

text.la: Spíritus tuus bonus dedúcet me in terram rectam: (11a) propter nomen tuum, Dómine, vivificábis me, in aequitáte tua.
text.en-US: Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land: (11a) for thy name's sake, O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

text.la: Edúces de tribulatióne ánimam meam: (12a) et in misericórdia tua dispérdes inimícos meos.
text.en-US: Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble: (12a) and in thy mercy thou wilt destroy my enemies.

text.la: Et perdes omnes, qui tríbulant ánimam meam: quóniam ego servus tuus sum.
text.en-US: And thou wilt cut off all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

text.la: Ne reminiscáris, Dómine, delícta nostra, vel paréntum nostrórum: neque vindíctam sumas de peccátis nostris.
